name: CWLTypeDefinition
description:
Note that 'Any' is equivalent to any of the non-null types.
Therefore, a nullable 'Any' explicitly specified by 'Any?' or its array-nullable form 'Any[]?' are not equivalent.

examples.title: Optional array of strings
examples.content: A nullable array of strings, combining the array (`[]`) and nullable (`?`) suffixes.
